plotSections.title: Searching for the Phylactery
bullets: The party continues testing items for phylactery-like properties after dinner at Langdale Stronghold.

The Hunched eagle marker Walker brought back from Grixto's hideout was tested and came back clean: no soul fragment or phylactery properties, staying dormant longer than the Helm did without reaction. It is crossed off the list.
Walker has nothing else in his inventory that could have belonged to the emperor; Dana and Sylan's items are mostly from the dragon hoard.
Ord mentions his Turquoise animal figurines but believes they came from the Sunder Chase, so they are unlikely candidates.

Sylan recalls a shark statuette (now held by Gerk) that turned into a real shark when activated with a magic word, and suggests the turquoise figurines may work similarly if an inscription or command word is found.

plotSections.title: Using the Lantern-Staff to Read the Helm
bullets: Sylan proposes using the Fused lantern-staff, which previously let Ord see souls attached to objects, to see which soul is attached to the Helm.

Dana inspects the lantern-staff with a strong Arcana check (22): a hardy wooden shepherd's-hook-style staff with a lantern at the end, clearly magical, with inscriptions in an archaic or arcane script scrawled along the lantern frame. She judges it a fairly typical magical item on superficial inspection.
Remembering that last use caused a vortex in the sky and blinded Gerk, Sylan goes alone to his room, with Dana asking him to close the blinds.

Sylan sheathes his sword, holds the staff like a banner, makes a Raven Queen hand sign, and recites the activation incantation ("In brightest day and darkest night... No evil shall escape my sight... Lantern keeper's light"), closing his eyes on the fourth line.

Throughout the stronghold the world turns noir-like: darks deepen, lights gain contrast, and color drains slowly toward Sylan's room until nearly grayscale. Everyone feels a sweater-weather chill, and Sylan sees the flash go out internally before becoming unsure whether his eyes are open.

chronologicalEvents: The Hunched eagle marker from Grixto's hideout is tested and shows no phylactery or soul-fragment properties.
Walker confirms he has no other items that could have belonged to the emperor.
Ord mentions his turquoise figurines; Sylan suggests they may need a command word, like the shark statuette Gerk now holds.
Sylan proposes using the lantern-staff to see the soul attached to the Helm.
Dana rolls a 22 Arcana on the lantern-staff and finds arcane inscriptions on the lantern frame.
Sylan retreats to his room, sheathes his sword, and recites the activation incantation with eyes closed.
The stronghold's color drains toward Sylan's room into a cold, grayscale noir state.
